result.title: Exact Dynamics and Finite-Sample Trajectory Recovery of Linear Recursive Feature Machines
result.summary: Recursive feature machines (RFMs) learn representations of data by alternating between fitting a predictor to a dataset and updating features of that predictor using the average gradient outer product (AGOP). Connections between AGOPs and feature learning in neural networks motivate linear RFMs as a simple setting for analyzing how representations evolve during training. Here, we study the dynamics and statistics of linear RFM in noisy multi-output regression with isotropic sub-Gaussian input data and targets generated by a low-rank teacher matrix of dimension $d$. We extend the known connection between linear RFM and iteratively reweighted least squares from the interpolating setting to ridge-regularized multi-output regression with noise. We show that the learned feature matrix remains close to its infinite-data ideal counterpart at every iteration. Namely, for $n$ samples, we show the error in the feature matrix decays as $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ with high probability. Experiments on real-world text and single-cell gene-expression data illustrate the features learned by this simple linear model.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究线性递归特征机（RFM）在有噪声多输出回归中的训练动态与统计性质，将线性 RFM 与迭代重加权最小二乘的联系推广到岭正则化噪声场景，并给出特征矩阵以 O(√(d/n)) 逼近无穷数据理想解的有限样本界，另用文本与单细胞数据做示例实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作刻画的是训练中表示随迭代演化的轨迹与可恢复性，可为 LVR 中 latent 状态随层/迭代更新的表示漂移、监督信号贡献分配与有限样本泛化分析提供理论工具线索，但其为非视觉的纯回归设定，与多模态推理的具体联系尚需核查。
